discover.title: Discover images

discover.description: Browse community images that have been reviewed and approved for public display.

discover.errorDescription: Public images could not be loaded. Try again later.
discover.emptyDescription: Approved public images will appear here.
discover.reportDescription: Choose a reason and add context so the moderation team can review it.
discover.reportFailed: A report for this image and reason already exists, or the report could not be submitted.

publicAlbum.emptyTitle: No public images in this album

reports.title: My reports
reports.description: Review the media reports you submitted and their moderation outcomes. Only your own reports are shown.

reports.emptyDescription: After you report a public image from Discover, its status will appear here.

home.title: Home
home.heading: Upload and manage your images
home.description: Upload images, revisit recent media, and keep an eye on your personal plan usage.

home.guestRecentDescription: Sign in to view your own upload history.

media.title: My images
media.heading: My images
media.description: Upload and organize your images. Only media belonging to your account appears here.
media.formatsHint: JPG, PNG, and GIF are supported. The server validates file type, size, and plan limits.
media.emptyTrashDescription: All images and derived files in the trash will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
media.shareDescription: Create a publicly accessible image link. It stops working when revoked or when the image is deleted.
media.shareCreated: Link created. Copy it now to keep the address.
media.signedURLDescription: Generate a temporary media address with an expiry. The storage object address is never exposed.
media.signedURLCreated: Signed URL created; it expires at {expires}.
media.hotlinkPolicyDescription: Choose whether this image accepts ordinary links, approved referrers, or signed URLs.
media.visibilityDescription: Public images can be embedded anywhere; private images require your signed-in session; unlisted images are available to anyone who has the link.
media.emptyDescription: Upload your first image to see it in your personal library.
media.trashDescription: Images removed from your library appear here.
media.errorTitle: Media action could not be completed

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Organize your own media into folders. This page never exposes other users' content.

shareLinks.title: Share links
shareLinks.description: Manage public share links you created. Only a token prefix is retained in the list; the complete address is returned once at creation.
shareLinks.emptyDescription: Create a share link from an image details page and it will appear here.
shareLinks.errorTitle: Share link action could not be completed

tokens.title: Personal API Token
tokens.description: Create personal API credentials for PicGo, ShareX, scripts, and CI. The complete token is shown only once after creation or rotation.
tokens.createDescription: Base capabilities always include uploading, reading your own image links, and deleting your own media.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.fixedScopes: Only upload, list/read your own images and links, and delete your own images are allowed. Orders, usage, folders, albums, sharing controls, and admin APIs are not exposed.
tokens.mediaRead: Read your own media list and details
tokens.createdDescription: The complete token cannot be viewed again after leaving this page. Never put it in a public repository, frontend bundle, or log.
tokens.confirmRotate: The old token will stop working immediately after rotation. Continue?
tokens.confirmDelete: This permanently deletes the token and stops it immediately. Continue?
tokens.emptyDescription: Create a token to use FastImg from PicGo, ShareX, scripts, or CI.
tokens.errorTitle: Token action could not be completed

errors.operationFailed: The token action could not be completed. Please try again.

plans.title: Plan and usage
plans.heading: Plan and usage
plans.description: Review your current benefits, storage and bandwidth, and available plans. The server calculates limits from your subscription snapshot.
plans.guestDescription: Guests can view the public plan catalog; sign in to view personal usage and subscription status.
plans.loginToViewUsageHelp: Sign in to view your storage, bandwidth, and plan entitlements.
plans.administratorDescription: Administrator uploads and media operations bypass member plan quotas. The displayed plan tier can still be assigned from the admin user editor.
plans.bandwidthNotMeteredHelp: Unrecorded traffic is not presented as zero usage.
plans.lifetimeBalance: Media and files in trash both count toward storage.
plans.purchaseNotice: The free plan is available by default. After signing in, choose a published paid price to create an order; benefits are granted only after the payment gateway confirms success.

billing.errorTitle: Payment action could not be completed
billing.errorDescription: The order or payment information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
billing.orderErrorDescription: The order does not exist, has expired, or is not accessible to this account. Return to the order list and try again.
billing.gatewayErrorDescription: The order loaded, but no payment channel is currently available. Ask an administrator to configure and enable a channel, then try again.
billing.paymentErrorDescription: The order loaded, but the payment request could not be created. Check the channel configuration or try again later.
billing.paymentProviderUnavailableDescription: The payment channel could not be reached and no charge was made. Try again later, or ask an administrator to check the provider API URL and network egress.
billing.paymentProviderRejectedDescription: The payment channel rejected this request and no charge was made. Check the provider credentials and order amount, then try again.
billing.cancelErrorDescription: The order loaded, but it could not be canceled. Please try again later.
billing.paymentPending: Waiting for payment confirmation. Use the test flow in development to verify the order lifecycle.
billing.fulfillmentNotice: Plan benefits are granted automatically after payment succeeds.
billing.ordersDescription: View your own plan orders and payment status.
billing.noOrdersDescription: Choose a plan and your order will appear here.

errors.loadDescription: Plans or usage could not be loaded. Refresh the page; if the issue continues, try again later.
